notes: No breadboard; the PIR sensor connects directly to the Pi header through three female-to-female jumper wires.
The catalogue has no female-to-female jumper type, so the generic jumper-wire is used.

Pi header pins (physical numbering): 5V = pin 2, GND = pin 6, GPIO4 = pin 7. This matches the image: red wire on the top-right 5V pin, black on the GND pin in the third row, orange on GP4 in the fourth row.

PIR VCC goes to 5V, which is within the sensor's 4.5-20 V supply range. The OUT pin goes to GPIO4. The manual does not say what voltage OUT swings to; many PIR modules output 3.3 V, which is safe for the Pi's 3.3 V inputs.
The wire colours come from the image.
